label: مواقف تحت الأرض
parking: Park straight inside an existing marked bay, leaving access clear; no curb distance unless a real curb adjoins.
ground: Scuffed covered concrete floor with faded bay paint, low surface reflectance.
background: Ordinary an underground parking lot details, everyday pedestrians, parked vehicles and surfaces only if naturally visible inside the unchanged selfie framing; no named landmarks.
angleReason: Standing at reachable arm length alongside the stationary vehicle keeps the face prominent; do not widen for the background.
goldenPeriod: after dusk under a real parking fixture

day.source: Filtered 5500K daylight only at the parking opening, no direct sun under solid roof.
day.shadows: One coherent direction away from actual daylight, with realistic contact shade.
day.reflections: Soft restrained natural reflections in glass and pearl-white paint.

night.source: One real ceiling parking fixture above the subject; downward 4000K light and unified overhead shadows.
night.shadows: One shadow direction away from the actual installed fixture.
night.reflections: Localized muted highlights on paint and side windows, no fill.
